_how_to_add: Everything in this file is published as a fact about the studio, so a number belongs here only once it is true. metrics: value is the real count, label the words under it, note one short line of proof. A metric left as "value": null is never rendered, which is how a figure the studio has not counted hides itself instead of showing a made-up placeholder; the two business counts below came from our own records, and a real number typed in counts up on its own. A figure written as "since": 2022 instead of a value is the current year minus that year, so an age keeps itself true rather than waiting for someone to edit it. milestones: date is a year, a span or a day we can point to in our own records, oldest first, and title and text one line each. The English words double as the translation keys, so a rewritten line falls back to English in every other language until it is added again to i18n/*.json.
